newsitem.title: USA: Addvantage Media to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Addvantage Media to redeem warrants.

text.p: Addvantage Media Group Inc said on Thursday it will redeem its 600,000 outstanding stock purchase warrants that were set to expire on December 31.
The period for exercising the warrants to buy one share of stock at $4 a share will now expire on November 22, Addvantage Media said.
Addvantage Media's shares are trading at 4-7/8.
Warrant holders who choose not to exercise their warrants by November 22, 1996, will be paid $0.05 per warrant on or about December 2, 1996, the company said.
The company said its balance sheet will improve with the exercise of the warrants.
Also, the company said its goal is to re-list the company's shares on the Nasdaq Small Cap market and it could satisfay the listing criteria after 1996.
There can be no assurance, however, that the company's shares will be listed, Addvantage Media said.
